records.name: DICE EDS and HSD Global Registry

evidence.claim: The DICE EDS and HSD Global Registry allows members of the EDS and HSD community to complete surveys and share medical information to assist with research into Ehlers-Danlos syndromes and hypermobility spectrum disorders.

The VEDS Collaborative is a group of patients, family members, researchers, and clinicians dedicated to developing a patient-centered plan for scientific research to improve the management of Vascular Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome.
The RDCRN Contact Registry connects interested patients to clinical trials underway within the RDCRN and allows patients to connect with research teams focused on particular diseases.

RED is a retrospective and prospective registry that collects clinical, functional, genetic, genealogical, imaging, surgical, treatment, and quality of life data for Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, currently recruiting participants.
Annabelle's Challenge is committed to driving person-centered research that transforms the landscape of vascular Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome management.
